author: CNN
description:
The Pentagon updated its war casualty database Saturday, recording more than 140 additionally wounded and restoring the four soldiers killed due to Iranian strikes last week amid questions about a lack of transparency over the war’s toll.

The Pentagon drew scrutiny from media outlets and lawmakers last week when killed and wounded numbers decreased in the Defense Casualty Analysis System, or DCAS, as Iranian attacks continued. CNN observed fluctuating casualty totals when monitoring the site on a minute-by-minute basis last week. The system now has a new tracking category for killed and wounded since July 7, when President Donald Trump claimed a new conflict with Iran began in a War Powers notification the administration sent to Congress earlier this month

title: Iran war: Casualty count exceeds 600 as Pentagon changes accounting

description:
A war of words between Iran and Ukraine has erupted after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said over the weekend that drones had targeted several ships in the Caspian Sea carrying military cargo from Iran to Russia.

Iranian officials have ramped up their threats towards Kyiv after this weekend’s attack. Iran’s regional governor Hadi Hagh-Shenas said the vessel had been carrying a cargo of iron and was sailing from Astrakhan to Anzali, “a safe and reliable corridor for commercial exchanges between the two ports,” while Zelensky said the drone attacks targeted "ships that were involved in transporting military cargo from Iran, as well as a warship."

author: CNN
description:
In the days after GOP Sen. Lindsey Graham suddenly died, a bipartisan Russia sanctions bill he had championed gained fresh momentum. But now, the bill is facing headwinds – with some Democrats raising concerns that it could hand too much power to President Donald Trump. 

The sanctions bill would impose mandatory sanctions on Russian leadership, including President Vladimir Putin, as well as oligarchs, state-owned enterprises, and foreign companies that support Russia’s defense industrial base. 

Bill Browder, a former top investor in Russia before Putin turned on him, explains how the bill would impact Putin and points out the importance of Ukraine's ability to strike Russia's economic interests. Also, former US ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor says he thinks Putin is "on his back foot."  

0:00 How would the new Russia sanctions bill target Vladimir Putin? 
2:17 Volodymyr Zelensky's leverage ahead of his trip to Washington DC 
4:58 Ex-Ukraine ambassador says Ukrainians are movin
title: Ex-top Russia investor says Putin could be in 'deep trouble'

description:
Vice President JD Vance and Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Gen. Dan Caine both raised concerns about escalating the war in Iran as President Donald Trump weighed the possibility during a White House meeting on Friday, a source familiar with the matter and a US official told CNN. 

On Friday night, the US appeared to pause its bombing campaign on Iran after nearly two weeks of consecutive nights of strikes. Operations are “on a hold,” a Department of Defense source told CNN. 

CNN's Zachary Cohen reports on the White House meeting. Also, CNN military analyst Cedric Leighton, CNN global affairs analyst Brett McGurk and The National editor-in-chief Mina Al-Oraibi discuss the state of play in the Iran conflict.
